note: Issue #45: the town style kit. A style is a preset id or plain words: 'metallic', 'snowy', 'pastel', 'red matte metal', 'pale blue glossy ceramic with gold trim', 'snowy dark steel'. Read by src/systems/planets/town_style.gd, which restyles every material the town's look is built from (LookMaterials: walls, paving, metal trim, props, awnings). Words: a colour sets the walls; a second colour (or one after 'with' / 'trim' / 'accent') sets the trims and painted bands; a shade before a colour changes it; a finish and a material set how shiny and how metallic. Unknown words are ignored (and listed by the parser, so a typo shows up in the tests). 'desert' is the port's own look: no changes. Add a colour or a word here and every planet can use it.

metallic.note: Brushed steel walls and hulls, cyan trim.

snowy.note: White walls under snow, ice-blue trim, snow drifts instead of sand.

pastel.note: Every building a different soft colour.

factions.note: Issue #393: the colours a place is marked with for whoever holds it (src/systems/look/look_materials.gd repaint). band: painted bands on the barracks, the gate towers and the watchtower banners; wall: the town wall and the gate lintel; mark: an outpost's band, door frame and banner; lamp: an outpost's corner lamps. The town swaps between them with the barracks guards, an outpost with its own.
